text:
leo_sales: Hey team — Avalon POC just ran a scaled soak (120 qps ramp). Observed slow TTFT spikes (~700-1200ms) and intermittent 429s after ~10m. Need a quick swarm to unblock demo tomorrow. Any immediate mitigations? :rotating_light:
anya_se: Ack. Can you paste sample request sizes (tokens in/out), model name, and whether you're using prefill/prefill_policy? Also is this hosted or dedicated?
leo_sales: Hosted (rand-region). Model: open-7b-v2. Avg input 60 tokens, avg output 180 tokens. Prefill enabled via client with 2 warmup calls. No special batch overrides from client.
raj_eng: Copying logs from their session (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-20T15:12:34Z] INFO  shard=shard-4 queue_len=190 batch_limit=128
[2026-03-20T15:12:34Z] WARN  prefill_kv_miss_rate=0.78 ttft_ms=820
[2026-03-20T15:12:35Z] ERROR 429 rate_limiter=token_bucket overflow=true
[2026-03-20T15:12:35Z] DEBUG routing=policy-default fallback=none
[2026-03-20T15:12:36Z] INFO  batch_window_ms=25 avg_batch_size=8
```
raj_eng: Two clear signals: (1) KV cache miss rate very high -> wasted compute and long first-token times, (2) request queue is growing beyond single-shard batch_limit -> backpressure and 429s from our token-bucket limiter.
anya_se: Immediate mitigations we can apply now (low-risk):
- Temporarily reduce batch_window_ms from 25 -> 10 to reduce per-request latency (tradeoff: slightly higher GPU overhead).
- Turn on aggressive prefill mode for this customer so we pre-populate KV cache for common prefixes.
- Route a small percentage (10-15%) of traffic to a quantized model variant to relieve shard pressure.
leo_sales: Can you toggle those live? I need the demo to the CISO tomorrow so timeline is tight. Also, Avalon will ask about cost for burst capacity.
raj_eng: I can push the routing and batch_window change now. Will monitor for 5-10m. Prefill toggle needs a short coordinated rollback test, but we can enable for their customer-id.
ops-bot: Action created: /ops run change-batch-window --customer avalon --window 10ms (run id: ops-7832).
anya_se: Also, ask Avalon to run a short warmup script we provide that sends 30 parallel prefill requests across a representative distribution (we'll give curl). That will drop KV miss rate quickly. Example curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \
  -d '{"model":"open-7b-v2","input":"<warmup prompt>","prefill":true}'
```
olivia_csm: I'll ping the customer success lead to coordinate the warmup and confirm demo window. Also forwarding the security questionnaire question: Avalon asked if enabling prefill increases persistent logs/retention. Need an answer for legal.
anya_se: Prefill only populates ephemeral KV cache; it does not change request logging or retention. We don't persist prefill data beyond the shard lifetime. I'll put a short explainer for legal.
leo_sales: Pricing Q: if they want guaranteed demo performance, what are options/cost delta vs hosted burst?
olivia_csm: Options: (A) Short-term metered burst (auto-burst) — quick enable, billed at premium burst rate for the period; (B) Reserved Dedicated pool — predictable throughput & SLA, monthly commitment. I'll loop in pricing but ballpark: Dedicated is ~3-4x cheaper per token at high sustained throughput vs metered burst. (will confirm exact numbers).
raj_eng: Quick notes for postmortem: investigate why prefill_kv_miss_rate was 0.78 despite warmups — likely mismatch in prefixing (client prefill uses slightly different prompt template) or concurrency ordering causing eviction. Recommend client use deterministic prefill prompts and run warmup immediately before the ramp.
anya_se: I'll set up a short A/B: enable aggressive prefill + batch_window=10 for 10m and monitor TTFT and 429s. If we see TTFT median <250ms and 429s disappear, we leave on for demo.
leo_sales: Perfect. Please post back metrics snapshot (ttft P50/P95, 429 count, kv_miss_rate) when you have them. Also, can we capture a sanitized trace for the CISO that shows no customer data persisted?
raj_eng: Will post traces and a sanitized dashboard link in this thread. Starting changes now.
ops-bot: Change-batch-window completed (ops-7832) — observed immediate batch_window_ms=10 on shards 2-6.
raj_eng: 6min after change: TTFT P50=210ms P95=480ms, 429s dropped to 1/min (from 8/min), kv_miss_rate down to 0.43. Still above ideal but big improvement.
anya_se: Good. Next steps: (1) have Avalon run our warmup script (2) we enable aggressive prefill for them (3) consider short-term route to quantized model if shard pressure persists. I'll prepare a short checklist for the customer. :thumbsup:
leo_sales: Thanks all — urgent ask for pricing writeup and legal note. Olivia, can you handle?
olivia_csm: On it. I'll attach pricing draft + legal blurb in the next hour.
leo_sales: Closing loop when demo verified. Thanks!
